title: AW28 Kids' Partywear Styling
research_period: AW28/29 colour previews (October 2026), AW27 fairs (September 2026), SS28 previews

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Long-range projection. AW28 kidswear fairs take place in January 2028. This report projects from the first AW28/29 colour forecasts, the AW27 fairs, kidswear brands' long-term practices and market drivers, and will be updated as evidence arrives.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Vibrant cobalt with a violet undertone, paired with white; deep wine red with cream and black; bright matcha green with chartreuse and ecru, in menswear and womenswear<sup>[1]</sup>
- Future Snoops' AW28/29 "Blocked brights": "Bold colour becomes an act of defiance, a refusal to disappear into the algorithmic mass"; blue leads, with red and purple rising, and cornflower as a new "anchor colour"<sup>[1]</sup>

design_implications:
- Line sparkle; no beads or sequins for under-3s.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, snaps and decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
commercial_implications: - Party buys sell close to events; buy shallow.

sources.title: Spotted on the catwalk: Future Snoops' colour trends for AW28/29
